items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So Wally Simpson from Baltimore, he finally married her, she hated my guts, hated Duke's guts.

ctx.x: I said, 'oh, you're the Prince of Wales.' He's heir to the throne.

So Wally Simpson from Baltimore, he finally married her, she hated my guts, hated Duke's guts. We were taking up too much attention, so he say, 'I'm leaving now. I got to go say hello to some friends, Sonny, I'll be right back though, don't you go nowhere.' 'I ain't going nowhere, Wale.' Call him the Wale, you know, he's the Prince of Wales, but that's too long, I say Wale, 'I'll be right here Wale when you get back.' He thought that was the cutest thing in the world.

He never forgot it. I called him the Wale. He followed us to Paris, to Scotland. He says, 'Sonny, what's my nickname?' I say 'You're the Wale, man, you're something else.' He thought that the was the greatest thing in the world. He never forgot it. Because we was friends up in Scotland, played a theatre, Sir Harry Lauder was the biggest Scotchman. We met him when he come in the Cotton Club, playing the Wintergarden in New York. He was the biggest thing that ever come out of Scotland. 'You take the high road, and…
